name: approval-certificate
title: Ethics approval
for_each: select id, name from applications where status = 'approved' order by name

sections.title: Approval
sections.sql: select name as reference, title, committee, investigator, department, pathway, approved_on, expires_on, next_report_due as first_report_due from application_detail where id = $1

sections.title: Conditions
sections.sql: select coalesce(conditions, 'None') as conditions, conditions_due_on as conditions_due from applications where id = $1

sections.title: Animals approved
sections.sql: select species, animals_approved as approved from applications where id = $1 and animals_approved is not null

sections.title: Amendments approved
sections.sql: select name, summary, decided_on from amendments where application_id = $1 and outcome = 'approved' order by decided_on

name: meeting-agenda
title: Committee agenda
for_each: select id, name from meetings where not held and meets_on >= ethics_today() order by meets_on

sections.title: Meeting
sections.sql: select m.name as meeting, c.name as committee, m.meets_on, m.closes_on as agenda_closed from meetings m join committees c on c.id = m.committee_id where m.id = $1

sections.title: New applications
sections.sql: select name as reference, title, investigator, pathway, reviewers, reviews_out from application_detail where meeting_id = $1 order by name

sections.title: Amendments waiting
sections.sql: select x.name, a.name as application, x.summary, x.submitted_on from amendments x join applications a on a.id = x.application_id where x.decided_on is null and a.committee_id = (select committee_id from meetings where id = $1) order by x.submitted_on

sections.title: Safety and conduct reports open
sections.sql: select e.name, a.name as application, e.kind, e.occurred_on, e.summary from events e join applications a on a.id = e.application_id where e.closed_on is null and a.committee_id = (select committee_id from meetings where id = $1) order by e.occurred_on

name: annual-committee-report
title: Committee annual report
for_each: select id, name from committees where active order by name

sections.title: Committee
sections.sql: select name as committee, kind, registration, quorum from committees where id = $1

sections.title: Membership
sections.sql: select category, count(*)::int as members, count(*) filter (where external)::int as external from members where committee_id = $1 and active group by category order by category

sections.title: Meetings in the last 12 months
sections.sql: select count(*)::int as meetings_held from meetings where committee_id = $1 and held and meets_on >= ethics_today() - 365

sections.title: Applications in the last 12 months
sections.sql: select count(*) filter (where submitted_on >= ethics_today() - 365)::int as received, count(*) filter (where decision in ('approved', 'approved with conditions') and decided_on >= ethics_today() - 365)::int as approved, count(*) filter (where decision = 'declined' and decided_on >= ethics_today() - 365)::int as declined, count(*) filter (where status = 'withdrawn')::int as withdrawn from applications where committee_id = $1

sections.title: Monitoring
sections.sql: select count(*) filter (where status = 'approved')::int as approvals_running, count(*) filter (where status = 'approved' and next_report_due < ethics_today())::int as reports_late from applications where committee_id = $1

sections.title: Safety and conduct reports received
sections.sql: select e.kind, count(*)::int as received from events e join applications a on a.id = e.application_id where a.committee_id = $1 and e.reported_on >= ethics_today() - 365 group by e.kind order by e.kind
